Options most servers never change. A change saves as you make it. Check what an option does before you change it.
How long, in seconds, the server waits after a file changes before it updates the library. From 1 to 3600.
How long, in seconds, the server batches changes before it refreshes a library. From 1 to 3600.
How many library items the server scans at once. 0 lets the server choose from its processor cores, and 1 scans one at a time. From 0 to 64.
How many images the server encodes at once. 0 uses one per processor core. Applies after a restart. From 0 to 64.
How long, in milliseconds, the server waits for a frame to be extracted from a video. 0 uses the server\'s own timeouts. From 0 to 600000.
How many items of user data the server keeps in memory. Applies after a restart. From 1 to 1000000.
How many days the server keeps its activity log; it deletes older entries each day. At least 1, to 3650.
How many minutes a session may be idle before the server counts it as inactive. 0 turns this off. From 0 to 1440.
